summary: Moving to post-quantum cryptography often involves hybrid schemes that combine post-quantum and traditional asymmetric algorithms. This informational RFC defines terminology for such schemes, serving as a reference so documents and discussions about them use consistent words.

eli5.summary: When two kinds of locks are used together, people need shared names for the parts. This is the dictionary for combining new quantum-resistant locks with old ones.

questions: what is a pq/t hybrid scheme
